profile.headline: Delivering consumer media experiences, 3D AR/VR applications, and enterprise services
profile.summary:
I am a Senior Software Engineer with over a decade of experience delivering consumer and enterprise software serving millions of users. My experience spans from consumer music and video players for Xbox and Windows, 3D AR/VR applications for HoloLens and Windows Mixed Reality, and geospatial capabilities for enterprise low-code platforms.

I am driven to improve customer satisfaction and team output through automated tests, static analysis, developer tools, thorough code reviews, technical mentorship, and data-driven decision making.

I am ready for anything, from debugging baffling native crashes in Windows source code, jumping into red-hot livesite incidents, and travelling to active industrial worksites for in-the-field device testing and customer interviews.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: - Designing and implementing cloud-based 3D content pipelines for enterprise AR/VR experiences

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Implemented 3D media controls for 360° VR videos on Windows 10.
- Delivered major front end features for numerous video applications on Xbox.
- Improved code quality by becoming a leading source of code review feedback to much positive reception from colleagues and superiors.
- Implemented responsive interfaces for Windows-based desktop, tablet, mobile, and Xbox applications.
- Developed and shared guidance on debugging Windows/Xbox platform issues and modern C++ coding practices.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Delivered numerous UI features for Windows-based photo applications.
- Improved developer efficiency by integrating industry web tools such as LESS CSS into web-based Windows applications.
- Collaborated with Microsoft Research to integrated research code into production quality features, such as panorama photo stitching and group photo stitching.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software developer at a startup developing GPS-tracked logistics software with Java.

positions.title: Intern - Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Developed an RSS photo screensaver using C++ and DirectX.

projects.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Layout
projects.description: Using Microsoft Dynamics 365 Layout, you can bring your designs from concept to completion with confidence and speed. Import 3D models to easily create and edit room layouts in real-world scale. Experience designs as high-quality holograms in physical space or in virtual reality and share and edit with stakeholders in real time.
